messages:
Maya (Support): Customer ACME hit intermittent 504s/502s starting ~09:40 UTC, ticket #12345. They say spikes correlate with token rotation window. Repro steps below.
Jon (SRE): Got it — assigning eng-sre. Any minimal repro curl + client logs?
Maya (Support): Minimal repro curl: 
```
curl -v -H \"Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>\" -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" -d '{"input":"short prompt"}' https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
```
Customer using SDK v1.4.2, default retry until success (5 retries).
Priya (Eng): Do we have proxy/auth logs around 09:40?
Maya (Support): Snippet (sanitized):
```
[2025-06-17T09:40:12Z] edge-42: upstream backend-12 request timed out after 3s
[2025-06-17T09:40:13Z] auth-service: rotating keys, refresh started id=rf-77
[2025-06-17T09:40:13Z] edge-42: auth check failed, 401 -> client retried
```
Luca (Infra): Looks like key rotation caused a brief auth failure window. Clients retried aggressively -> connection storm -> queue exhaustion -> 504s.
Jon (SRE): Quick mitigations to apply now: 1) widen auth-rotation grace window, 2) scale edge pool +4, 3) add short-term 429 for second-level immediate retries to break the retry herd. Applying 1 & 2 now.
deploy-bot: deploy started: edge-pool-scale v2025.6.17-01 by Jon
Priya (Eng): SDK follow-up: v1.4.3 will add an in-flight token-refresh guard and exponential jittered backoff by default. Recommend customer upgrade.
Maya (Support): Sent customer note: we scaled edges and implemented temporary retry-shedding; please upgrade SDK to v1.4.3 when available and set retries=3 with expo backoff as a short-term config.
Jon (SRE): Edges scaled and config rolled; 504s trending down, p95 latency improving. Monitoring 10m.
Maya (Support): Customer confirms reduced errors, no 5xx in last 20m. They will test heavy load tomorrow morning.
Luca (Infra): Action items: add metric token_refresh_fanout.count and circuit_breaker.trip_count; alert on >5% over baseline.
Priya (Eng): Opening GH issue and will mark as SDK/ops priority.
Maya (Support): Thanks team. Will keep ticket open for 24h then close if stable. :thumbsup:
